query: SELECT ro.id, ro.title, ro.offerType, ro.businessId, b.name as bizName, b.isClaimed, bt.name as bizType, bt.slug as bizTypeSlug FROM referralOffers ro LEFT JOIN businesses b ON ro.businessId = b.id LEFT JOIN businessTypes bt ON b.businessTypeId = bt.id WHERE ro.isActive = 1;
